objective: Review the implemented repo-owned Verilator overlay patch descriptor/apply-check payload, accept only the descriptor and patch applicability evidence, and select a separate build-only validation definition gate before any native parser support claim.

review_decision.weakest_point: The implementation proves that the descriptor is valid JSON and that the patch applies to the pinned Verilator checkout, but it still does not prove that Verilator builds, that upstream regression tests pass, that the option is documented, or that sidecar execution is connected.
accepted_because: the descriptor pins Verilator v5.048 to peeled release-tag commit d0aa828c217410fffc73d92077b6f4f54830357c
the patch touches only src/V3Options.h and src/V3Options.cpp
the first native option surface is limited to --sim-accel sidecar-gpu plus positive --sim-accel-states and --sim-accel-steps
the implementation record reports descriptor JSON validation and git apply --check exit code 0
vendored Verilator source, third_party/verilator, public CLI changes, runtime/ABI changes, execution, and timing all remain out of scope

reviewed_patch_scope.known_validation_caveat: the first patch uses std::atoi for positive-count parsing, so strict rejection of non-numeric suffixes is not yet proven and must be revisited by a later validation/build-test gate

reviewed_verification.verification_scope: descriptor syntax and patch applicability only; this is not Verilator build, native parser support, upstream regression, execution, timing, or sidecar integration evidence

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_overlay_patch_build_only_validation_gate
must_define: the exact clean-checkout command sequence for applying the overlay patch to the pinned Verilator commit
the smallest Verilator build or compile validation command that can check the patched source without widening into runtime integration
which parser-behavior checks remain separate from build-only validation unless explicitly selected later
which upstream documentation and test_regress files remain deferred because the current patch marks options undocumented
which claims remain blocked until a build result or parser execution result exists
must_not_claim: Verilator upstream regression tests pass with this patch

non_claims: not a landed upstream Verilator patch
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
